about: Reference pack for Bluebonnet (docs/jclass-1), an invented J-Class sloop of 1937. Period and modern photos of the real Js on Wikimedia Commons, public domain or plain CC BY only (no NC, ND or SA), for checking our own lines' proportions and look by eye: nothing is traced or measured off them into the model, and no real yacht's drawing is used. Files are not committed: python3 -I Tools/shipkit/fetch_refs.py Tools/shipkit/jclass/refs.json Data/Reference/raw/ships/Bluebonnet (git-ignored). Credit the CC BY photographers if a picture is ever shown in the docs.
